title: The last handoff checkpoint fires before compaction starts
why: From lane c203, Nov 1 17:43 CST: the handoff hook's last checkpoint sits at the window minus 50k (450k on 500k), but compaction may start near 384k, so that checkpoint may never fire.
note: Inferred, not measured at 500k. Counter-reading: the coordinator's session showed an autocompact threshold of 441,600 (17:13 CST) and got a checkpoint at about 297k; triage 5 got checkpoints from about 290k. Step: measure the real compaction point first, then set the last checkpoint below it. Ready: no open question.
